description: Calculates a saved model as it stands, with the same engine as the browser builder: ownership after every event for a cap table, proceeds by holder for a waterfall (at the saved exit, or up to 10 exitValuations you pass), a fund's lifetime totals plus the fund by year (granularity "quarter" or "none" to change that), or a forecast's outputs, the same as its compute tool. For a fund, workbook true adds a 24-hour link to the live Excel workbook; that needs the Venture Capital Model, the same as the browser's Excel export. Free: uses no calculations. Needs a signed-in connection.

exitValuations.description: Waterfall only: sale prices to run, up to 10.

kind.description: "cap-table" (Cap Table builder), "waterfall" (Exit Waterfall builder), "fund" (the web Venture Capital Model), or "unit-economics", "saas-forecasting", "ecommerce-forecasting" (the web models with the same names as their compute tools).

workbook.description: Fund only: add a link to the live Excel workbook.

name: run_saved_model
title: Run a saved model
